section.headlineDefault: Straightforward pricing for one-time and recurring work.
section.supportingCopy: Most clients book this as a one-time project. Monthly options are for recurring work.
section.footnote: Clear scope, clear pricing, simple proposal. Educational and artist-led initiatives receive preferred rates.
